headline: Human Rights Committee subcommittee to discuss budget recommendations for human rights education and community events.
summary: The Education and Rapid Response Subcommittee will review its history and purpose, then discuss and recommend a budget to the main HRC body for education objectives, including sharing human rights resources and hosting community events.
